name: Of Love and Saving the World
source:
The Destroyer's army is approaching. To stop the world from being conquered by the evil leader, Lena gets sent back in time to kill his father and prevent him from being born. But thing are never simple... or are they?

[From [url=https://lavinnia.itch.io/of-love-and-saving-the-world]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
毁灭者的军队正在逼近。为了阻止世界被邪恶领袖征服，莉娜被送回到过去杀死他的父亲并阻止他出生。但事情从来都不简单……是吗？

[来自[url=https://lavinnia.itch.io/of-love-and-saving-the-world]Itch.io[/url]]
